item.title: [−2] Two container ships sunk near Hormuz, one with over 2,500 containers on a US-approved route
item.description:
Oil flows through the strait crashed again and traffic plunged. Iran called the latest US response 'insufficient' and talks are stalled until after the US midterms. Brent held near $105–106. Escalating.

Aviation, shipping & logistics: headwind (−2) — Freight and insurance spike

Why it matters: Sinking container ships widens the threat from energy to all trade, raising freight and insurance for Indian exporters and importers and keeping crude costs high.

Market gauges: Fiscal & trade balance −2, Inflation outlook −1, Growth outlook −1

Confidence: high · horizon: weeks
